scenario: Present-day Flood Zone 2 and 3 for rivers and the sea, ignoring the benefits of flood defences. Flood Zone 1 is every area not shown.
selection: Features whose published polygon intersects [-1.08, 51.39, -0.84, 51.5], clipped to that box plus a 0.005° margin.

processing.coordinates: WGS84 longitude/latitude as served (CRS84), rounded to 5 decimal places (about 1 m)
processing.simplification: Clipped as above, then Douglas–Peucker, every removed vertex within 4 m of the kept line; features grouped by zone, source and origin
